name: Flux 2D & Klein_9b ver 5.0.3
notes: Flux/Klein API graph extracted from ComfyUI PNG metadata produced by the Desktop workflow. StoryDriver injects the positive prompt into node 75:74.text, injects the negative prompt into node 75:67.text, randomizes node 75:73.noise_seed, and retrieves the saved image from SaveImage node 9. ComfyUI Desktop owns all model, CLIP, VAE, sampler, size, scheduler, LoRA, and quality settings. Target first-image time is under 120s on the AMD/RX 7900 XTX runtime when LM Studio is unloaded through Auto Image Priority; warm Regenerate should be faster if models stay resident.
